info.title: Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - System Core Settings
info.description:
Core system settings: hostname, version, boot, config-register, and other fundamental device parameters.

**YANG Model:** [Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - System Core Settings.yang](https://github.com/YangModels/yang/blob/main/vendor/cisco/xe/17181/Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - System Core Settings.yang)

get.description:
Retrieve version configuration from the device via RESTCONF.

Returns the current operational or configuration state of this resource.

put.description:
Create or replace version configuration on the device.

This replaces the entire resource — any fields not included will be removed.

patch.description:
Partially update version configuration on the device.

Only the fields included in the request body are modified; other fields remain unchanged.

delete.description:
Remove version configuration from the device configuration.

This deletes the resource and all descendant data.
